Docs.summary: This class specifies a supported media size.

remarks.para: This class specifies a supported media size. Media size is the dimension of the media on which the content is printed. For example, the #NA_LETTER media size designates a page with size 8.5" x 11".
Portions of this page are modifications based on work created and shared by the Android Open Source Project and used according to terms described in the Creative Commons 2.5 Attribution License.
